title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Firms using large language models under fixed budgets must decide which model to call and whether to retry a failed task. Because a call's charge is revealed only after completion, one long response can exhaust the remaining budget and leave later tasks unserved. Our objective is to maximize the number of tasks solved before service stops. We develop a contextual bandit policy, ADP-HT, which learns each model's task-specific success probability and constructs conservative cost estimates from coarsened response-length labels on a quantile grid with $2^K$ intervals. The policy weighs predicted success against these costs, adjusting the cost penalty to realized spending and the budget available per remaining task. Under calibration, local regularity, and grid-coverage conditions, we bound the excess allowance in the policy's conservative cost estimates. translated_title: 路径预算约束下的大语言模型路由：基于K比特尾代价学习的在线分配
translated_abstract: 在固定预算下使用大语言模型的企业必须决定调用哪个模型，以及是否重试失败的任务。由于一次调用的费用只有在完成后才会被揭示，一个过长的回复可能耗尽剩余预算，导致后续任务无法得到服务。我们的目标是在服务停止前最大化已解决任务的数量。我们开发了一种上下文赌博机策略ADP-HT，它学习每个模型的任务特定成功概率，并在具有 $2^K$ 个区间的分位数网格上，基于粗化的回复长度标签构建保守的成本估计。该策略将预测成功率与这些成本进行权衡，并根据实际支出和每个剩余任务可用的预算来调整成本惩罚。在校准、局部正则性和网格覆盖条件下，我们对策略保守成本估计中的超额容许量进行了界定。在固定样本量下，增大 $K$ 可以减少离散化误差项，但会增加……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出上下文赌博机策略ADP-HT，通过学习各模型的任务特定成功概率，并利用K比特粗化回复长度标签构建保守成本估计，在固定预算下智能路由大语言模型调用与重试决策，以最大化在预算耗尽前完成的任务数量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ADP-HT, a contextual bandit policy that learns model-specific success probabilities and constructs conservative cost estimates from K-bit coarsened response-length labels to route LLM calls and retries under a fixed budget, maximizing the number of tasks completed before the budget runs out.
